description: MainActivity class for an Android application implementing a calculator with voice input, theming, history, and AI explanation features. Contains UI setup, event handlers, dummy expression evaluation, and voice recognition integration.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for calculator app with voice recognition, theming, and history features.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI references, theme, event listeners, and calculator buttons.

methods.name: setupCalculatorButtonListeners
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to number and operator buttons for input entry.

methods.name: setupTheme
methods.description: Configures the UI theme based on dark or light mode.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between dark and light themes.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Establishes click event listeners for key UI controls like send button, voice input, theme toggle, and history.

methods.name: setupHistoryList
methods.description: Initializes the history list adapter and item click handling.

methods.name: fillFromHistory
methods.description: Populates input field from a selected history item.

methods.name: toggleHistoryPanel
methods.description: Shows or hides the calculation history panel.

methods.name: processUserQuery
methods.description: Handles user input, invoking calculation and updating UI and history.

methods.name: showResult
methods.description: Displays the calculation result and AI explanation.

methods.name: addToHistory
methods.description: Adds a new calculation entry to history.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Dummy logic for evaluating expressions: supports basic operations and simple natural language.

methods.name: startVoiceInput
methods.description: Requests permission and initiates voice recognition.

methods.name: openSettingsScreen
methods.description: Stub method to open app settings.

inner_classes.name: HistoryItem
inner_classes.description: Data class representing a calculation history entry.

methods.name: displayText
methods.description: Returns string representation of history item.
